name: iScanner App: Lifetime Subscription (iPhone, iPad & Android)
description: iScanner lets you scan, annotate, and share documents using your smartphone or tablet. It supports iPhone, iPad, and Android devices with a single lifetime subscription.
meta_title: iScanner App Lifetime Subscription for iPhone & Android
meta_description: Scan, annotate, and share documents with iScanner app's lifetime subscription for iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.

Share or export scans in multiple formats.
Access a lifetime subscription with no recurring fees.
Compatible across iOS and Android platforms.
